name: Momoji Naomitsu
source:
An excellent ninja who isn't talked about much.
A wandering Iga ninja with a subdued and faded atmosphere.
With his first class ninja skills he raised Hotaru as a Kuniochi.
A few years ago he went missing while out on a mission.
